text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's the Senior Class!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!!
Come on, let's head to the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, isn't that Epiphaneia!?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
"Epi-chaaan!!" "I watched the Kikuka Sho!"
"I became a huge fan of yours...!"
"Good luck in the Senior Class too~!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!!
Thank you, everyone!!
Although she already had a large fanbase to begin with, the high expectations from Cesario and the others' fans—as their junior—played a significant role as well.

Her shaky run had tempered everyone's expectations...
but her performance in the Kikuka Sho completely turned the tide.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
In the current medium-distance division... the classic route, I believe you are the only true representative of this generation!
—You're the one who will lead the next era!!

Just last month, a certain legendary Umamusume
announced her retirement from the front lines—
her name, the "Tyrant" Orfevre.
After becoming a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume, she defined an entire era, finishing 2nd in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—Japan's long-cherished racing dream—two years in a row.
choice_data_list: (The fans are looking for the next main star now—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, everyone!
You can put all your hopes on my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I will become the sun of a new era!
And bestow destiny upon everyone!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I wanna be Epi-san's destiny too!
What should I do!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do?!
The first time I ever felt destiny with a person was—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because it's you, Trainer!
You're one of a kind to me, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Guhh~... I see!
At least for the race, I'll cheer with all my might!
I'm counting on you to take care of Epi-san, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's pray!
Let's do it full of energy on the count of three!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, use your voice!
That way it'll reach the heavens! Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!!
choice_data_list: I hope Epi keeps growing even more!!
I hope Epi gets to smile a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm so happy!!
Thanks to you, I feel like I'll stay full of energy forever!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You by my side need to stay healthy
and keep watching over me too. I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure?
I'll be watching closely!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
There's no ceiling to my strength!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: If you want, we could break through an actual ceiling too! Like your room, maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I just thought being able to see the sky was nice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How about that?!
choice_data_list: It looks nice, but that's not quite what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I know! Let's have fun together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I was so focused on your wish that I completely forgot!
Let's see, my wish is—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
May your days always be joyful,
wonderful, and beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You made a wish about me too, didn't you!
After all, you can make your own wishes come true yourself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no!
I meant for you too, of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make you happy for another whole year!
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'm relying on you.

text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia's support among fans was growing.
However, this wasn't just among regular fans――

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, Epi-san...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
You watched the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a-ah...! I-It reached you...
...Um, I...—

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I was thinking about giving up
on running. Because I'm just not cut out for it at all...

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, after watching your race—
I made up my mind,
and decided to aim for my debut once more...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because of my influence,
destiny has started to run...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll definitely be fine! After all, you look up to me!
Give it your all!!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Thank you very much...!
choice_data_list: The number of girls looking up to you is steadily growing.
More and more girls are starting to look up to you, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Mm, yeah! I'll win the Osaka Hai too, make them feel destiny even more—and turn that into their cheers!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Oh!!
Even the voice of destiny is telling us to go over there!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, that Trainer's
got an incredible start dash!"
"Guess they've been put through the wringer..."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo!! It was you!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Epi-san.
Hehe, did the voice of fate give you another nudge?
choice_data_list: Sorry, is it okay if I drop in?
Sorry, is it okay if I bother you for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it~
I was just wanting to take a break anyway.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you're sweating like crazy!
Have you been training this whole time?"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Come to think of it,
has it already been about five hours?
choice_data_list: Working hard right from New Year's, huh?
Working hard right from New Year's, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to take on Dubai in the near future.
So... I want to hone my skills even more.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!!
That's amazing, logo! Overseas, huh...!
Logotype hadn't produced notable results since the Satsuki Sho. With this new challenge, she likely wants to break through the feeling of stagnation at home.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
The amazing one is you, Epi-san~.
You're the biggest rising star right now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, she's always shining so brightly...
What an incredible classmate."

Logotype narrowed her eyes against the glare.
Solid and earnest as she is, she might still have her own inner thoughts about the current situation.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing too, aren't you!
I can just tell!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo, with you, it's definitely, absolutely going to be fine! I can hear the voice of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because you're the one who lit a fire in me—
my very first rival!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Epi-san...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As rivals...
we must deliver results worthy of the title~.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll join you too!
Let me go warm up!

Drawing inspiration from the rivals
she competed with in the Classic races—
she became even more fired up for the race ahead.
